name: Delhi Summer Open 2013
information: Registration Fee : INR 175 will be collected from participants. On day registration is compulsory between 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM on Day 1 of the competition . If the participant fails to register within the given time slot, Competitor will not be allowed to participate in competition. No exceptions would be entertained. Pre-Registration is not considered as Registration. Only People registered on-day would be eligible to participate in the Event.
